purpose: Hand-written release-equivalent checks for the native credential-vault add-on used by School mode.

checks.evidence: The packaging path runs electron-builder install-app-deps for win32 x64.
The exact win-unpacked directory is removed before Electron packaging so stale native binaries cannot satisfy the probe.
Launches the final artifact in probe mode and loads keytar through the packaged preload and main-process IPC handler, with the native binary presence checked before launch.

The probe-only preload is packaged separately; the normal preload and shared desktop API type contain no packaged-vault probe capability. The real junction fixture imports the shared production reparse validator, accepts an ordinary profile, and rejects a junction.

Stages school-mode-provenance.json before electron-builder, packages it through extraResources, and has the final-artifact main-process probe read and compare product, app id, package version and candidate commit.

Binds the probe service to package version and candidate commit, writes and reads an ephemeral value in isolated workers, deletes it with cumulative bounded attempts, then requires post-delete absence and the exact worker-operation relation.
Candidate product, app ID, commit, package version, product name, and unpacked executable digest are recorded in release identity and compared by the packaged probe.
